test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six students (Ritu, Vinayak, Arnab, Maya, Fathima and Ankur) are sitting around a circular table facing the centre(but not necessarily in the same order). Ritu is an immediate neighbour of both Vinayak and Arnab. Arnab is sitting second to the left of Fathima. Fathima is sitting second to the left of Vinayak. Vinayak is an immediate neighbour of both Ritu and Maya. Who is the immediate neighbour of both Fathima and Arnab?
solution:
Given: Six students (Ritu, Vinayak, Arnab, Maya, Fathima and Ankur) are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Arnab is sitting second to the left of Fathima. 

2) Fathima is sitting second to the left of Vinayak. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71115dbdce5cd461c8fee11728cfa115e6ee6cef7895db497238c4289379ef37.png] 

3) Ritu is an immediate neighbour of both Vinayak and Arnab.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d52370d2276897903c5c24ea94860d0d1f178063fd9bbbfe47ed9731bd20c5d1.png] 

4) Vinayak is an immediate neighbour of both Ritu and Maya. 

After positioning Maya only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. Ankur.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2638374d3306b81474a170ed65df5615392cec24c472bc51e059daabcd0486c.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Ankur is the immediate neighbour of both Fathima and Arnab.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
